critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiter memory fallback in /app/backend/utils/api_rate_limiter.py is process-local. Behind a multi-worker uvicorn (--workers > 1) it will under-count across workers; today the deploy uses --workers 1 so it is fine, but note for future scale-out — Redis must remain the primary and health-checked path.

The pre-existing 'cert-delivery' warning still lives in backend.err.log from the prior startup; if a log-based alert scanner is used, filter by timestamp >= last restart to avoid a false positive on cleared config.

POST /api/auth/password/reset returns 403 CSRF_BLOCKED before the rate-limit check runs, so its documented 5/300s limit cannot be observed by an anonymous unauthenticated client. If password-reset abuse is a concern from unauthenticated origins, ensure the rate-limit runs before CSRF or expose a public-safe throttle.
